synthesizedFacts.fact: Dark circles under the eyes can be caused by increased melanin deposition, aging, genetics, and lifestyle factors such as lack of sleep and poor diet.
Melanin deposition under the eyes is often due to post-inflammatory pigmentation, which can be triggered by sun exposure, dermatitis, or rubbing the eyes.
Treatment options for dark circles include lifestyle changes, topical treatments, cosmetic procedures, and in some cases, surgical interventions.
Dark circles are more prevalent in individuals with darker skin tones due to higher melanin levels.
